review_summary: The differential captures the key clinical picture but required adjustments to probability weights and clarification of several low‑evidence entries. All high‑severity lab abnormalities are at least plausibly linked to a diagnosis, though further targeted testing (spirometry, α‑1‑antitrypsin level, secondary hypertension panel, anemia work‑up, echocardiogram) is essential to refine the list.
